Project Overview
ChronoSentiment — a trading strategy replay/certification system with a React UI, Rust API backend (services/api), and a governance framework enforcing canonical schemas, event taxonomy, and semantic laws across the full stack.

## Completed Work
1. Reviewed project structure and architecture
2. Collected all .md files and documentation
3. Read all UI components
4. Cross-referenced docs vs UI implementation
5. Generated discrepancy report
6. Evolved report into constitutional governance document (4 laws + authority hierarchy)
7. Added Section 22: Concept Extraction Pathway
8. Created 5 canonical schemas: event, replay_response, observatory_state, governor_telemetry, decision_trace (in schemas/canonical/)
9. Deep-dived entire codebase — audited every UI element against canonical schemas
10. Wrote schemas/canonical/README.md — Law Zero audit surface
11. Full-stack backend audit (services/api, cs-ingest, observatory) appended to README
12. Implemented first fully schema-conformant replay endpoint (POST /inspect_strategy)
13. Added real SHA-256 signature to certify.rs
14. Reshaped InspectStrategyResponse DTO to emit narrative_blocks[] and trace_signature
15. Added certification_state enum to replay/inspect responses
16. Added source_layer and kernel_signature to EventWrapper/MinimalEvent
17. GA determinism test passed (test_run_ga_api_determinism: 1 passed, 0 failed)
18. Ran full cargo test -p api suite — all 5 tests pass (165s)

28. Created scripts/verify_manifest.py — Replay Fingerprint Verifier
29. Created scripts/configs/phase2e_aapl_overnight_gap.json — companion config for emitter
30. Backend narrative_blocks[] handler — updated match arms to SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE event types
31. certification_state propagation — taxonomy-aware logic in inspect_strategy_handler
32. Removal of frontend fallback resolution — eliminated ambiguous truth selection in UI
33. Ran cargo test after handler changes — 9 passed, 0 failed
34. Phase 3 P7: Observer-only services/ui — eliminated groupAndNarrateEvents(); ARTIFACT-002 eliminated; ARTIFACT-009/010/011 registered
35. Phase 3 P3: Forbidden semantic linter — scripts/lint_forbidden_semantics.py operational; 103 violations baseline
36. Updated transitional_artifacts.md — ARTIFACT-009/010/011 registered; ARTIFACT-002 marked ELIMINATED
37. Phase 3 P1: Schema conformance CI — scripts/validate_schema_conformance.py operational
38. Phase 3 P2: Event taxonomy validator — NON_CANONICAL_EVENT_TYPE rule in linter
39. Fixed event.schema.json — replaced pre-taxonomy event_type enum with 16 canonical taxonomy types (DRIFT resolved)
40. Fixed dto.rs forbidden synonyms — renamed TopStrategySnapshot.live_score→ga_fitness, execution_score→execution_fitness
41. Re-ran scripts/validate_schema_conformance.py --static — confirmed 20/20 PASS (exit code 0)
42. Phase 3 P4: Replay certification engine — cryptographic lineage-awareness (causal closure, replay parity, chronology integrity)
43. Analyzed scripts/certify_equivalence_v1.py — confirmed non-redundant; unique re-execution step in verification chain
44. **Fixed scripts/certify_equivalence_v1.py line 147** — changed `scripts/verify_manifest_v1.py` → `scripts/verify_manifest.py` (canonical path)

## Key Technical Decisions
- **Law Zero**: schemas/canonical/*.schema.json are the single source of truth for all field names and types
- **Law One**: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for all event_type values; no legacy aliases
- **16 canonical event types**: ORDER_INTENT, ORDER_ENTERED_QUEUE, QUEUE_PROGRESSION, PARTIAL_FILL, ORDER_FILLED, ORDER_CANCELLED, MARKET_NEW_ORDER, MARKET_TRADE, MARKET_CANCEL, POSITION_OPENED, POSITION_CLOSED, EQUITY_SNAPSHOT, REPLAY_SESSION_START, REPLAY_SESSION_END, CERTIFICATION_VERDICT, GOVERNOR_TELEMETRY
- **Forbidden fields**: live_score, execution_score, fitness, score, rank, ranking, perf, performance, result, outcome, value (semantic_registry.md §6)
- **Observer-only UI**: frontend must not compute/derive — only render what backend emits
- **SHA-256 trace_signature**: cryptographic certification of replay lineage
- **CertificationState enum**: Certified | Provisional | Rejected | Pending
- **narrative_blocks**: Vec<NarrativeBlock> (not Vec<String>)
- **TopStrategySnapshot**: renamed live_score→ga_fitness, execution_score→execution_fitness to avoid forbidden synonyms
- **Verification chain**: emit_manifest_v1.py (create) → verify_manifest.py (verify internal integrity) → certify_equivalence_v1.py (prove determinism via re-execution of cargo run --bin trace_replay)

## Relevant Files & Code
- `scripts/validate_schema_conformance.py` — Schema conformance CI, 20 static checks, **currently 20/20 PASS**
- `scripts/lint_forbidden_semantics.py` — Forbidden semantic linter; 103 violations baseline; includes NON_CANONICAL_EVENT_TYPE rule
- `scripts/emit_manifest_v1.py` — Canonical replay manifest emitter (step 1 of verification chain)
- `scripts/verify_manifest.py` — Replay Fingerprint Verifier (step 2 of verification chain; internal integrity only; no re-execution)
- `scripts/certify_equivalence_v1.py` — Replay equivalence certifier (step 3 of verification chain; re-executes cargo run --bin trace_replay for both cognitions, re-emits manifest, compares manifest_id hashes to prove determinism); **bug on line 147 fixed** (was `verify_manifest_v1.py`, now `verify_manifest.py`)
- `scripts/configs/phase2e_aapl_overnight_gap.json` — Companion config for emitter
- `schemas/canonical/event.schema.json` — Updated with 16 canonical event types (DRIFT resolved)
- `schemas/canonical/replay_response.schema.json`
- `schemas/canonical/observatory_state.schema.json`
- `schemas/canonical/governor_telemetry.schema.json`
- `schemas/canonical/decision_trace.schema.json`
- `schemas/canonical/README.md` — Law Zero audit surface
- `services/api/src/dto.rs` — InspectStrategyResponse, MinimalEvent, CertificationState, TopStrategySnapshot (ga_fitness/execution_fitness), NarrativeBlock, GovernorTelemetryDto, ObservatoryStateDto
- `services/api/src/inspector.rs` — EventType enum (16 variants, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE serde), Inspector struct, classify_event()
- `services/api/src/certify.rs` — Real SHA-256 replay signatures
- `docs/governance/semantic_registry.md` — Canonical term authority
- `docs/governance/event_taxonomy.md` — 16 canonical event types
- `docs/governance/transitional_artifacts.md` — ARTIFACT-002 ELIMINATED; ARTIFACT-009/010/011 registered
- `docs/governance/ontology.md` — System identity freeze
- `docs/governance/runtime_contract.md` — Infrastructure invariants
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — Main UI (observer-only, fallback resolution removed)
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyColumn.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/NarrativeBlock.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/ComparisonPanels.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/index.css`

## Current Status
**Phase 3 P4 complete. certify_equivalence_v1.py bug fixed.** The full three-step verification chain is intact and correct: emit_manifest_v1.py → verify_manifest.py → certify_equivalence_v1.py. All 20 schema conformance checks pass. The governance framework is fully operational.

## Pending Tasks
- **Phase 3 P5**: `scripts/audit_law_one.py` — Frontend Law One audit automation (observer-only architecture enforcement)
- **Phase 3 P6**: `scripts/check_artifact_expiry.py` — Transitional artifact expiration checks (automated ARTIFACT-NNN lifecycle tracking)
- **Phase 3 P8**: Authority-layer annotations in Rust crates — explicit `// [LAYER: KERNEL]` tagging in source
